nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=70 beats='Miri arrives Monday morning to feed the three school hens. Big brown Bess clucks hello. Orange Pepper pecks grain. But small gray Lucy is gone from the henhouse.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri searches behind the toolshed and by the gate. She finds a gap in the fence near the rose bushes. A chicken could squeeze through there easily.'>>

choices.label: Check the park across the street

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Mrs. Chen listens carefully and nods. She says Lucy might have escaped through the fence. She gives Miri a bag of sunflower seeds. Lucy loves these seeds.'>>

choices.label: Search the park with the seeds

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The park is full of trees and bushes. Miri walks the paths calling Lucy softly. A girl riding a bike notices her and stops.'>>

choices.label: Ask the girl if she saw a hen

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri shakes the seed bag through the park calling Lucy. Birds come, but not Lucy. She sits by the pond feeling worried and tired.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri walks to the blue house next to school. An old man is sweeping his porch. He smiles and asks what she is looking for.'>>

choices.label: Ask if he saw anything strange

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The girl says she just arrived. She has never seen a chicken here. But she smiles and offers to help search with Miri.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=60 beats='Miri pushes through tall bushes. A rabbit darts out. Only leaves and dirt, no hen here.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='At the pond Miri sees ducks and a turtle. Then a flutter of gray and white. Lucy is on a rock in the middle of the water!'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The overgrown garden is quiet. Miri hears soft peeping. Between weeds and old fence rails, Lucy pecks at seeds happily.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='When Miri says Lucy is missing, his eyes light up. He tells her a small gray hen visited his yard yesterday morning and ate from his garden.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='He says maybe he saw a gray bird on Monday. He is not quite sure. He invites Miri to look around his house and yard.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The girl and Miri search deeper into the trees. Bright sun comes through the leaves. They find feathers under an old oak tree.'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='The sun is setting. Miri sits on a park bench tired. An older girl sits down next to her and asks if something is wrong.'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='Cold water splashes Miri. She wades slowly toward the rock. Lucy flaps and squawks. Miri reaches her and grabs her muddy but safe.'>>

choices.label: Run back to school with Lucy

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri finds a man fixing his fence. She tells him about Lucy. He smiles and gives her a long stick to help with the rescue.'>>

choices.label: Use the stick to help Lucy

nodes.body: <<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='Lucy looks up and clucks happily. She hops toward Miri. Miri scoops her up warm and dusty from her rest in the garden.'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='In his big vegetable garden, Miri spots gray feathers and wings. Under a tomato plant Lucy sleeps in a cozy dust bath.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The feathers are from another bird, not Lucy. But ahead by the stream, something moves. A small gray bird shape in the ferns!'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The girl listens and says she wants to help. She knows many kids in the neighborhood. They search together until her mom picks her up.'>>

choices.label: Ask her mom to help tomorrow

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Miri walks home sad. Mrs. Chen will be upset. Maybe Lucy will come back. Miri cannot sleep that night, worried about Lucy alone outside.'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='With the long stick, Miri carefully hooks Lucy and pulls her to shore. Lucy squawks and flaps. The man helps Miri carry her back safe.'>>

choices.label: Thank the man and rush home

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Mrs. Chen laughs at soaking wet Miri and muddy Lucy. Lucy is safe and hungry. Miri learns that small hens can be tough. She fixes the fence gap.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Mrs. Chen hugs Miri and praises her bravery. Lucy clucks happily in the henhouse. Miri thanks the neighbors. Lucy stays closer to home.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Lucy wakes and clucks at Miri. The old man gives tomatoes to take home. Lucy has made a friend. Miri visits him and Lucy every week.'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='Lucy runs deeper into the trees. Miri and the girl follow, calling and calling. Lucy stops by a stream and waits for them.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The girl's mom is kind and friendly. She drives them around calling for Lucy. No sign of her, but she promises to help search tomorrow too.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Tuesday morning, Miri checks the fence area with bread crumbs. The sun rises pink over the school yard. She calls Lucy softly.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Mrs. Chen thanks the kind man. Lucy is safe and excited to see Bess and Pepper. Miri feels brave. She learns to never give up.'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='Miri kneels down slowly and whispers soft clucks. Lucy stops running and hops toward her. Miri catches her warm and safe.'>>

choices.label: Carry Lucy out of the woods

nodes.body: <<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Miri and the girl draw Lucy's picture and write her name. They hang posters around the neighborhood. That evening, a neighbor calls!'>>

choices.label: Run to the neighbor's house fast

nodes.body: <<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miri scatters bread crumbs around the fence and calls softly. Nothing at first. Then a familiar cluck and Lucy walks out from behind the shed.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Miri and the girl bring Lucy back to school. Mrs. Chen is relieved and grateful. The girl becomes Miri's best friend. They help care for Lucy.'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='Mrs. Lee from down the street has Lucy! Lucy got stuck behind boxes in her shed. Mrs. Lee fed her and kept her safe and warm.'>>

choices.label: Thank Mrs. Lee and take Lucy home

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Miri hugs Lucy tight. Lucy was hiding behind the shed the whole time, scared. Miri fixes the shed door so it stays open. Lucy is home.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The posters worked! Mrs. Lee was happy to help. Lucy gets treats. Miri learns that asking for help makes a big difference. The girl stays her friend.'>>
